title: Az: Janab Raza Ali Sohail Sahab.
body:
Qaime Ke Dar Pe Shaah Ne Rokar Yeh Di Sadaa.
<<MINI>>
Zainab ((asws).......Zainab S.A. Tumhare Bachon Ne Waada Wafa Kiya.
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ladte Rahe Furaat Ki Jaanib Na Ki Nazar.
Qurbaan Hone Deen Pe Baandhe Hue Kamar.
Wo Teen(3) Din Ki Pyaas Mein Wo Josh Wo Wigha.
<<MINI>>
Zainab (asws)... Zainab (asws) Tumhare Bachon Ne Waada Wafa Kiya.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Badh Badh Ke Waar Karte the Lekar Ali (asws) Ka Naam.
Bhooke the Teen(3) Din Se Wo Dono the Tishnakaam.
Tegh O Sinaa O Teeron Ko Har Simt Thi Fiza.
<<MINI>>
Zainab (asws)... Zainab (asws) Tumhare Bachon Ne Waada Wafa Kiya.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Dono Pe Har Taraf Se the Wo Zulm Al-amaa'n.
Tegho'n Se Choor Choor Thi Bachon Ki Pasliya'n.
Ghode Se Wo Zamee'n Pe Gire Waa Musibata.
<<MINI>>
Zainab (asws)...... Zainab (asws) Tumhare Bachon Ne Waada Wafa Kiya.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Laasho'n Ko Ran Se Laaye the Jab Shaah E Mashraqain.
Qaimon Mein Shaah E Dee'n Ke Tha Har Simt Shor O Shain.
Karte the Sar Ko Peet Ke Saidaniya'n Buka.
<<MINI>>
Zainab (asws)....... Zainab (asws) Tumhare Bachon Ne Waada Wafa Kiya.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Sar Taa Qadam Lahoo Mein the Zainab (asws) Ke Dono Laal.
Masoom Teen(3) Roz Ke Faaqo'n Se the Nidhaal.
Mamu Pe Apne Aun O Muhammad (asws) Hue Fida.
<<MINI>>
Zainab (asws)...... Zainab (asws) Tumhare Bachon Ne Waada Wafa Kiya.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Zainab (asws) Hain Sabr Karna Tumhe Zindagi Tamaam.
Matam Tumhe Hain Karna Sada Zindagi Tamaam.
Armaa'n Sabhi Bekaar Gaye... Ghar Tera Lut Gaya.
<<MINI>>
Zainab (asws).... Zainab (asws) Tumhare Bachon Ne Waada Wafa Kiya.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Matam Sohail Aun O Muhammad (asws) Ka Hai Bapa.
Majlis Mein Pursa Lene Ko Aayi'n Hain Fatima S.A.
Nauha Yeh Lab Pe Anjuman E Asghari Ka Tha.
<<MINI>>
Zainab (asws)....... Zainab (asws) Tumhare Bachon Ne Waada Wafa Kiya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Az: Janab Raza Ali Sohail Sahab.
